content.title: Chapter 82 - PURCHASING AND CONTRACTS — Sec. 82-81. - Informal award protest—generally.
content.summary:
(a)
Required.
Before filing a formal protest of an award, an aggrieved person must first file an
               informal award protest notice with the purchasing manager.
(b)
Standing.
Only an actual bidder who is aggrieved by an award may protest that award.
(Ord. No.
4774
, § 1, 8-16-2021)
